subject: Request to shift demo to allow prep and data access
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Barnes <alexandra@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to shift demo to allow prep and data access

Hi Alexandra —

Thanks again for scheduling the demo for this week. We have a small scheduling / readiness ask: our solutions team has a travel conflict on Wednesday morning (flight back late Tuesday), and Marcus needs a few more hours to ingest the sample workload traces and build a short prompt set that mirrors your typical queries. Would you be open to moving the live demo from Wednesday Aug 20 10:00 AM PT to Thursday Aug 21 1:00 PM PT? That shift gives us an extra afternoon to do an internal dry run and to load the sample data securely.

If Thursday doesn't work, we're also available Thursday 10:00 AM PT or Friday afternoon. We want the session to be interactive; to make the time useful we'd like to:
- get a small sample payload (CSV/JSON) and a short list of 5 representative prompts
- receive temporary read-access to a staging S3 folder or upload to our secure link
- confirm a 60–75 min agenda (intro, integration pointers, live queries, Q&A)

I've attached a quick prep_checklist.pdf that outlines the items above and the minimal schema we need. If the timing is tight, we can run a 30-minute kickoff and then a follow-up sandbox session.

Appreciate you flagging whatever times work — I'll update the calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0184

Attachment: prep_checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Alexandra Barnes <alexandra@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift demo to allow prep and data access

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the heads up. I will be traveling Wednesday (out of the country) and won't be able to join anything scheduled that morning, so moving off Wednesday is fine. Thursday Aug 21 at 1:00 PM PT works for me.

We can provide a small sample CSV with anonymized patient IDs and event timestamps — I will ask our data ops team to strip PHI and send a sample. If you need any specific field names, tell me and I'll include them.

If anything changes with travel, I'll let you know, but for now please move the invite to Thursday 1pm. We're excited to see the live prompts against our traces.

Alexandra Barnes
Director of Product, GreenLeaf Health
alexandra@greenleafhealth.com

On Mon, Aug 18, 2025 at 09:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:

Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift demo to allow prep and data access

Perfect — thanks, Alexandra. I updated our internal calendar to block Thursday 1:00 PM PT and will send an updated invite after Marcus confirms the link for secure upload.

Two quick asks to make the demo high-impact:
1) Can you provide one representative CSV (<= 10MB) with the columns you expect in the production workload? Marcus listed a minimal set in the checklist (id, event_time, event_type, payload) — if you use different names just indicate the mapping.
2) If possible, add 2–3 example prompts/questions you want the model to answer against the traces (e.g., "Which patients had two or more readmissions in 90 days?"). That will let us craft a short prompt set and save live time.

Marcus — can you confirm S3 upload or our secure intake link and whether we need an IAM role or temporary pre-signed URL? Also flag any concerns about sampling so we can advise Alexandra's data ops team.

Thanks — I'll hold the new time tentatively and finalize when Marcus confirms.

Best,
Jasmine

On Mon, Aug 18, 2025 at 10:05 AM Alexandra Barnes <alexandra@greenleafhealth.com> wrote:
> (reply quoted)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Alexandra Barnes <alexandra@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift demo to allow prep and data access

Hi all —

I can take Thursday 1pm. For the upload: we can accept either a pre-signed S3 URL or you can use our secure intake link (https://redwood.ai/safe-upload/GLH-41). If you choose pre-signed S3, please scope it to a single file and set expiry to 48 hours. Minimal schema we need (columns):
- id (string)
- event_time (ISO8601)
- event_type (string)
- payload (JSON or free text)

If the file is JSONL, please compress to .gz for speed. We'll only ingest a small sample (<= 10k rows) for the live session. I'll ingest it on Wed evening PST and run a dry-run to generate the prompt set; I'll share the short prompt list by Thursday 10am.

Also, please confirm whether you want us to demonstrate streaming latency numbers and per-token cost estimates (we can show ballpark numbers vs. batch inference).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Hi Marcus / Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear checklist. I've asked data ops and they just uploaded an anonymized sample to the pre-signed S3 link you provided. File name: sample_payload.csv (attached copy). Schema matches your minimal columns; we included two example prompts at the top of the CSV as comments. Travel ended Wednesday evening so Thursday 1pm should be perfect.

We've also copied procurement on the calendar update in case you need a PO or paperwork ahead of the session. Looking forward to Thursday.

Best,
Alexandra
